# Sell your app with Stripe. Let the license keys take care of themselves.

> Sell desktop apps, plugins and CLI tools with Stripe and issue signed license keys automatically. Generate a key pair, sign a test license and verify it right in your browser, then run the open-source server in your own account. Free, MIT, no per-license fee.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
